title: finding(app-shell): Studio's app preview mis-renders a spec-valid locale-map label — the app label prints [object Object], a nav item with a map label is dropped, and a map-label group reads (unnamed)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` public door, measured. The objectui#11027 dev ran a render probe of the Studio app preview (`AppPreview`) at objectui `335a6c38c`; it was not committed. A plain-string nav label on the same mount rendered, as the control.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the landing of PR objectui#11098 (objectui#11027), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings`. That PR's contract review (`5890732852`, ③d) confirmed it at source as pre-existing and not made worse by the PR. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx`, read at objectui `origin/main` `88fbd793d`. The spec types all three as `I18nLabel`, a plain string or a per-locale map.

1. **The app label.** The header renders `{String(label)}` (`:262`), so a locale-map app label prints `[object Object]`, and the authored text (e.g. `CRM`) is absent.
2. **A nav item's label.** `normalizeNav` keeps a label only when `typeof it.label === 'string'` (`:128`). A childless nav item whose label is a map is dropped together with its target: in the probe, `Accounts` and `account` were both absent.
3. **A group's label.** The same rule falls back to `label || unnamed` (`:148`), so a group whose label is a map reads `(unnamed)`.

## Why it matters

An author who localizes the app's name or its navigation, which the spec invites, sees a broken or incomplete preview in Studio. A nav item vanishes rather than being flagged. The console's own navigation resolves the same maps, so the preview disagrees with what users will see.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Resolve each of the three through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale)` in the designer locale. PR objectui#11098's new area list in the same file already does this: `readAreas` resolves `label` and `description` and never stringifies. Keep today's fallback only for a label that is truly absent.

Pins: a map app label, a map nav-item label and a map group label each render the resolved text under en and zh, and no `[object Object]` appears. Plain strings are the control.

Serial: objectui#10862, which covers this file's designer chrome strings, is queued on the same file.

## Dedupe

The 1100 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `normalizeNav`: 0 hits.
- `AppPreview`: 6 hits, none about authored label maps:
  - objectui#11027 and objectui#10862 (the designer chrome);
  - PR objectui#10880, objectui#10862's slice, which moved chrome strings and notes the app's label and name as not counted;
  - PR objectui#11041, PR objectui#10570 and objectui#7469.
- `(unnamed)`: 1 hit, PR objectui#10880, about BookPreview's group fallback.
- `String(label)`: 1 hit, PR objectui#10411, in the lookup dropdown.
- Absent control `zzqq_never_written_token_4242`: 0 hits.

No card covers these three sites.
